movement.title: Movement
movement.libraryHint: Pick a short one, all under 2 minutes.

session.completeBody: Your body thanks you. Back to it!

neck-roll.name: Neck release
neck-roll.summary: Ease neck tension from screen time.
steps: Sit tall and relax your shoulders.
Tilt your head to the right, ear toward shoulder, hold gently.
Tilt to the left and hold gently.
Drop your chin to your chest and roll your head slowly.

shoulder-roll.name: Shoulder rolls
shoulder-roll.summary: Wake up your shoulders and upper back.
steps: Shrug both shoulders up to your ears, hold 2 s, release.
Roll your shoulders backward in big circles.
Switch direction and roll forward.

standing-stretch.name: Full-body reach
standing-stretch.summary: Lengthen the spine and boost circulation.
steps: Stand up, feet hip-width apart.
Interlace your fingers and reach up high, breathe in.
Lean to the right, then to the left.
Lower your arms and breathe out slowly.

wrist-stretch.name: Wrist stretch
wrist-stretch.summary: For hands that type all day.
steps: Extend your right arm, palm facing out.
Gently pull the fingers back with your left hand.
Switch hands and repeat.
Circle both wrists slowly.

chest-opener.name: Chest opener
steps: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Draw your shoulders back, lift your chest, look ahead.
Hold and breathe deeply.

calf-raise.name: Calf raises
calf-raise.summary: Activate your calves after long sitting.
steps: Stand tall, lightly holding the desk if needed.
Rise onto your toes and hold for 2 s.
Lower slowly and repeat at a steady pace.

eye-rest.name: Eye rest
steps: Look away from the screen.
Focus on something about 6 metres away.
Blink slowly a few times, then close your eyes.

walk.name: Short walk
walk.summary: Walk a few laps and refill your water.
steps: Stand up and walk at an easy pace.
Relax your arms and let them swing.
Grab a glass of water on the way.

seated-twist.name: Seated twist
seated-twist.summary: Loosen up your spine and mid back.
steps: Sit tall with both feet flat on the floor.
Twist to the right, hold the chair back with your right hand, look over your shoulder for 3 breaths.
Come back to the center, then twist to the left for 3 breaths.

side-bend.name: Side bend
side-bend.summary: Stretch both sides of your torso without leaving your seat.
steps: Sit tall, rest your hands on the desk, relax your shoulders.
Raise your right arm and lean to the left. Hold.
Switch arms and lean to the right. Hold.

tricep-stretch.name: Triceps stretch
tricep-stretch.summary: Ease the back of your arms and shoulders after long typing.
steps: Raise your right arm overhead and sit tall.
Bend your right elbow so your hand reaches between your shoulder blades.
Gently pull the right elbow behind your head with your left hand. Hold a few breaths.
Switch to the left arm and repeat.

cat-cow.name: Seated cat-cow
cat-cow.summary: Wake up your spine and relieve a tired back.
steps: Sit tall with your hands on your thighs.
Breathe in, lift your chest and gently look up.
Breathe out, round your back and tuck your chin. Repeat slowly.

chair-squat.name: Chair squat
chair-squat.summary: Wake up your thighs and glutes with just a chair.
steps: Stand in front of a chair, feet shoulder-width apart, arms stretched forward.
Push your hips back and bend your knees until you lightly touch the chair.
Press through your heels and stand up slowly, keeping your back straight.
Stand tall, squeeze your glutes, then repeat at an even pace.

desk-pushup.name: Desk push-up
desk-pushup.summary: Strengthen chest, shoulders and arms, very gently.
steps: Place both hands on a sturdy desk edge and step back so your body is a straight plank.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the desk, keeping your body straight.
Push back up and repeat at an even pace.

quad-stretch.name: Quad stretch
quad-stretch.summary: Lengthen the front of your thighs after sitting for long.
steps: Stand tall and hold the desk with one hand for balance.
Bend your right knee and bring your heel behind you.
Hold your ankle with your right hand and pull the heel toward your glutes, knees together.
Hold a few breaths, release, then switch sides.

forward-fold.name: Forward fold
forward-fold.summary: Release your back, neck and hamstrings.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward from your hips with a straight back and let your hands slide down.
Let your head and arms hang, knees slightly soft, and breathe deeply. Rise up very slowly.

march.name: Marching in place
march.summary: Warm up your body and get the blood flowing.
steps: Stand tall with your arms relaxed.
Lift your right knee to hip height while your left arm swings up.
Switch sides: left knee up, right arm up. Repeat at an even pace.

ankle-circles.name: Ankle circles
ankle-circles.summary: Help blood flow down to your feet.
steps: Sit tall and lift your right foot off the floor.
Draw big circles with your ankle, 5 times clockwise.
Reverse the direction, then switch to the left foot.

deep-breathing.name: Deep breathing
deep-breathing.summary: Slow your heart rate and calm your mind.
steps: Sit tall and rest one hand on your belly.
Breathe in through your nose for 4 counts, letting your belly rise.
Hold for 4 counts.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth for 6 counts. Repeat.

leg-raise.name: Seated leg extension
leg-raise.summary: Activate your thighs without getting up.
steps: Sit tall with both feet on the floor.
Straighten your right leg in front of you, hold for 2 seconds, then lower it.
Switch to the left leg and repeat at an even pace.
